description:
Create a file uploader for a configured product BEFORE placing the order. Returns upload URL(s) and uploader IDs.

NOTE: For most cases, using uploader:true directly in placeOrder is simpler — Probo returns the upload URL(s) in the order response.
Use createUploader only when you need the upload URL BEFORE placing the order (e.g. to pre-validate files or for a custom upload flow).

Pre-order upload flow:
1. configureProduct({productCode:"banner-510", options:[...]}) → get calculation_id from the response
2. createUploader({calculationId: 68937, callbackUrl: "https://your-site.com/callback"}) → get upload URL + uploader IDs
3. Upload file to the returned URL (uploadFileToUploader or uploadFolderToUploader)
4. placeOrder with uploaders:[{id: <uploader.id>, external_id: <uploader.product_id>}] on the product

The callback URL receives a notification when the upload is complete.

callbackUrl.description: URL to receive callback when upload completes

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the uploader interface

name: createUploader
